observations: Three photos show a large flat-screen TV displaying colorful images: a hotdog, a pizza, and a child eating ice cream.
The TV has a thin bezel and is mounted on a stand with visible plastic wrapping on the legs.
The screen is bright and vibrant, with no visible dead pixels or cracks in the photos.
The background shows a blue and white tiled wall, suggesting a shop or showroom setting.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OLAMIDE ALUBARIKA' overlaid on all three images.
No brand or model is visible on the TV frame, stand, or screen in any photo.
The TV appears to be turned on and displaying content, but no interface or menu is shown.

claims.evidence: No brand or model visible on the TV in any photo. The seller's text cannot be trusted as proof.
The screen displays sharp images, but resolution cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
No internal components or settings menu shown. Cannot verify processor from photos.
No information about refresh rate visible in photos. Claim is incomplete and unverifiable.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV's bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
Photo of the screen displaying a solid white or black screen to check for dead pixels or burn-in.
Video clip showing the TV powering on, navigating menus, and playing content.
Photo of the back of the TV showing ports and serial number.
response.reason: The seller claims a specific Samsung OLED model, but no brand or model is visible in the photos. Without proof of identity and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation and hidden defects are high.
